summary: Nauticus Robotics filed an 8-K reporting an executed waiver from a holder of its Series C Convertible Preferred Stock. The preferred's certificate of designations would have triggered an event if any Series C shares remained outstanding on or after September 30, 2026. The holder waived that specified event from September 30, 2026 through December 31, 2027, including the dividend-rate step-up to 18%, incremental dividends, and the 125% Triggering Event Conversion multiplier, while preserving the existing 120% conversion calculation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or management change is involved. Watch for expiration risk after 2027.
